title: Principal Business Analyst – US P&C Insurance & Product Specialist
description: Job Description Principal Business Analyst – Insurance Domain & Product Specialist Company: Solartis Location: Chennai, India Experience: 12–18 Years Function: Product Engineering / Business Analysis / Insurance Domain Employment Type: Full-time Domain Preference: US Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance / InsurTech 1. Role Overview Techfully is looking for a highly experienced Principal Business Analyst – Insurance Domain & Product Specialist to strengthen its insurance domain expertise, product analysis capabilities, and functional delivery excellence. The individual will play a critical role in bridging the gap between complex insurance business requirements, Solartis platform capabilities, product configuration, and engineering implementation. The role requires a combination of deep insurance domain expertise, strong business analysis capabilities, product functional knowledge, and the ability to independently lead complex requirements and product definition initiatives. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Customer Engineering, QA, and AI Engineering teams to translate insurance business concepts into structured product definitions, functional specifications, business rules, workflows, validations, and implementation-ready requirements. An important part of this role is to build organizational knowledge and improve the competency of junior Business Analysts through mentoring, structured knowledge sharing, functional reviews, and reusable documentation. This is a senior individual-contributor and functional leadership role. The person is expected to be hands-on with complex insurance analysis while providing functional guidance and mentoring to the broader BA organization. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Insurance Domain Expertise and Functional Leadership  Act as a subject matter expert in US P&C insurance business processes, products, and workflows.  Interpret complex insurance product documentation, policy forms, rating manuals, underwriting guidelines, and regulatory requirements.  Develop a deep understanding of insurance product structures, coverages, limits, deductibles, endorsements, exclusions, and policy conditions.  Understand insurance product configuration, rating methodologies, underwriting rules, and policy lifecycle processes.  Provide functional guidance to Business Analysts, Product Managers, Architects, and Engineering teams.  Identify missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or incomplete insurance requirements.  Validate functional interpretations against insurance business practices and applicable source documentation.  Establish standardized insurance terminology, definitions, and reusable functional reference models.  Act as a point of escalation for complex insurance domain questions and functional interpretation. B. Complex Business Analysis and Requirement Management  Independently lead complex business analysis initiatives from discovery through functional specification and validation.  Conduct requirement discovery workshops with customers, business stakeholders, product teams, and internal SMEs.  Analyse business requirements and convert them into detailed functional specifications.  Define business processes, functional workflows, business rules, field metadata, dependencies, and validations.  Develop detailed user stories, epics, acceptance criteria, and functional requirement documents.  Identify functional gaps, process exceptions, business dependencies, and edge cases.  Evaluate the impact of requirement changes across products, workflows, rating, underwriting, forms, and integrations.  Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, traceable, and implementation-ready.  Independently manage complex requirements without continuous supervision from existing senior BAs.  Review and validate functional deliverables prepared by junior and intermediate BAs. C. Insurance Product Definition and Configuration  Lead functional analysis of insurance product definitions and product configuration requirements.  Translate insurance product manuals and related documents into structured product definitions.  Define product hierarchy, product attributes, coverages, limits, deductibles, rating factors, and underwriting conditions.  Analyse insurance rating methodologies, rating tables, factors, formulas, modifiers, and calculation dependencies.  Interpret state-specific insurance variations, product exceptions, and applicability rules.  Define policy forms, endorsements, form applicability, and document-related functional requirements.  Identify statistical coding and regulatory reporting requirements where applicable.  Ensure insurance product definitions are consistent across source documents and functional specifications.  Work with platform specialists to determine how insurance product concepts should be represented in Solartis.  Identify reusable product capabilities versus customer-specific requirements. D. Solartis Platform Functional Expertise  Develop a comprehensive understanding of Solartis platform capabilities, architecture, configuration mechanisms, and functional workflows.  Understand how insurance products are represented and configured within the Solartis platform.  Analyse product requirements against existing platform functionality and configuration options.  Identify standard platform capabilities, configuration opportunities, extension requirements, and functional gaps.  Work with solution architects and engineering leads to validate functional feasibility.  Help define reusable configuration patterns and standardized functional implementation approaches.  Maintain functional documentation covering platform capabilities, limitations, dependencies, and implementation patterns.  Support platform knowledge transfer to new BAs and other engineering teams.  Participate in functional design reviews, solution walkthroughs, and product acceptance activities. E. Product Management Support and Product Capability Development  Collaborate with Product Managers to evaluate customer requirements and identify opportunities for common product capabilities.  Identify recurring customer requirements that can be converted into reusable platform features.  Provide functional inputs for product roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.  Evaluate the business impact, functional complexity, dependencies, and implementation implications of proposed features.  Challenge requirements that introduce unnecessary customization or duplicate existing functionality.  Contribute to product capability documentation, functional specifications, and feature acceptance criteria.  Support product demonstrations and functional walkthroughs when required.  Help maintain alignment between customer requirements, product strategy, and platform capabilities. F. Business Analyst Mentoring and Capability Development  Act as a functional mentor for junior and intermediate Business Analysts.  Guide BAs in insurance domain understanding, requirement analysis, functional documentation, and platform knowledge.  Conduct regular knowledge-sharing sessions on P&C insurance concepts and Solartis platform capabilities.  Review BA deliverables and provide structured feedback.  Establish templates, standards, checklists, and functional documentation guidelines.  Create reusable examples of insurance product definitions, business rules, rating specifications, and workflows.  Develop practical learning paths and competency assessments for junior BAs.  Gradually enable junior BAs to independently handle standard and moderately complex requirements.  Reduce dependency on existing senior BAs for routine requirement clarification and functional reviews. G. AI-Assisted Business Analysis and Knowledge Management  Collaborate with AI Engineering teams to identify opportunities to automate repetitive business analysis activities.  Provide insurance domain expertise for AI-assisted insurance document understanding and product digitization.  Define expected extraction structures for insurance products, coverages, rating factors, underwriting rules, and forms.  Validate AI-generated insurance product definitions and functional requirements.  Help establish canonical insurance data models, business terminology, and domain taxonomies.  Define business validation rules and exception scenarios for AI-generated outputs.  Contribute to AI-assisted requirements generation, test case generation, and functional validation workflows.  Help create an approved insurance domain knowledge repository containing validated business concepts, examples, and reusable functional patterns.  Ensure that AI-generated insurance interpretations are traceable to source documents and validated by authorized domain experts. 3. Insurance Domain Knowledge – Mandatory / Strongly Preferred Strong experience in US P&C insurance is highly preferred. The candidate should have substantial knowledge of: Insurance Product and Policy Lifecycle  Property & Casualty insurance products.  Policy administration and policy lifecycle management.  Quote, rating, underwriting, binding, issuance, endorsement, renewal, and cancellation.  Carrier, MGA, broker, and agent operating models. Insurance Product Configuration  Product definitions and product structures.  Coverages, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and endorsements.  Insurance forms and form applicability.  State-specific product variations.  Product eligibility and underwriting rules. Rating and Underwriting  Insurance rating methodologies.  Rating factors, rating tables, and calculation rules.  Premium calculation and rating dependencies.  Underwriting eligibility, referrals, restrictions, and exceptions.  Risk classification and rating-related data requirements. Insurance Documentation and Compliance  Insurance product manuals.  Rating manuals.  Underwriting guidelines.  Policy forms and endorsements.  State-specific supplements and regulatory requirements.  Statistical coding and insurance reporting requirements.  Familiarity with ACORD standards is an advantage. Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, policy administration platforms, rating engines, and insurance product configuration solutions will be particularly valuable. 4. Technical and Functional Knowledge  Strong understanding of enterprise insurance technology platforms.  Experience with product configuration and policy administration systems.  Understanding of business rules engines, rating engines, workflow engines, and integration concepts.  Ability to understand APIs, data structures, JSON, XML, and database concepts.  Experience working with Agile product development and software engineering teams.  Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and requirement management tools.  Ability to interpret technical architecture and evaluate functional implications.  Awareness of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and document intelligence applications in insurance technology.  Experience working with structured metadata, data dictionaries, and canonical data models. 5. Experience and Qualifications Mandatory:  12–18 years of overall professional experience in insurance, InsurTech, or enterprise technology.  Significant experience in Business Analysis, Insurance Product Analysis, or Insurance Functional Consulting.  Strong hands-on experience in US P&C insurance business processes.  Proven experience independently handling complex insurance requirements.  Experience translating insurance business needs into detailed functional specifications.  Experience with insurance product configuration, rating, underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes.  Strong stakeholder communication and requirement management skills.  Demonstrated experience mentoring or reviewing the work of other BAs. Preferred:  Experience with insurance SaaS platforms and policy administration systems.  Experience with rating engines and insurance product configuration platforms.  Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, or insurance technology vendors.  Previous experience as an Insurance Product Specialist, Lead BA, Business Architect, or Insurance Functional Consultant.  Experience with Solartis or similar insurance technology platforms.  Experience supporting product modernization and digital transformation initiatives.  Exposure to AI-driven insurance product digitization and document intelligence.
